steps: Opened title screen, paged the crisis picker to Ceasefire or Collapse, chose United States
Read the mission, took office, chose staff pick on Peace by Tuesday, executed
Read the debrief pages and the newspaper
Month 3: opened Mission panel (goals list), tapped Map; the page froze and never recovered
scenarios.notes: Never got to test whether my choices end the Ukraine war. The Ukraine war itself never appeared in the debrief; hostages and a corruption scandal took the desk instead.

steps: After the freeze, restarted the browser (the saved game was gone, new guest)
Picked One Term, scrolled the tiny nation list to Ukraine, Story difficulty
Took office as Zelensky, chose Renegotiate the terms, executed, read the month page
Month 2 execute: page froze again, screenshots timed out
scenarios.notes: Only one month of the term played. Machine load was about 110 during the run (many browsers at once), so the freezes may be environmental, but I cannot tell that as Ruth.

friction.expected: Tap a story and see it clearly
friction.happened: Crowded: globe, crisis card, mode tabs, side list all at once; side list is cut to two rows; the label under the globe overlaps the pinned crisis name

friction.where: Title screen, One Term nation list
friction.happened: List shows two rows in a small window; I scrolled too far and my tap on Ukraine did nothing, the button still said Australia
APPR, STAB, LEGIT, CAP, TENS, GDP in tiny letters; I would not know STAB or LEGIT without guessing

friction.expected: Know what 'Approve 4' approves and what the diamond count means
friction.happened: 'Approve 4', '1 left', 'Orders 2/6', 'In person 0/3' are unexplained; the 'Top / Below / Bottom sheet' tip is jargon-ish and I dismissed it

friction.expected: See clearly which option I chose
friction.happened: After 'Approve staff pick' the card still said 'Your call' and I could not tell whether the hostage crisis had been answered; it had
Tapping by label did not respond; only a tap at the exact point worked for Mission; Map made the page freeze
North Korea missile headline sits under a peace-talks picture with a Putin quote about an embassy

friction.expected: Be told what to do to end the war
friction.happened: Goals are clear (guns fall silent, approval 65%) but nothing says which move helps; the month was spent on hostages and a scandal
Page froze twice (after Map tap, after second Execute); all taps timed out; a restart lost my saved game

bugs.title: Tablet page becomes unresponsive after Map tap and after executing a month
steps: Open Mission chip, tap Map (first freeze)
Alternatively start a Term, execute month 1, then execute month 2 (second freeze)
bugs.actual: All clicks and screenshots time out for minutes; goto also times out. Host load was ~110 with many parallel browsers, so this may be load and not the game

bugs.title: A fresh browser lost the saved game
bugs.actual: No saved games yet (guest id stored per browser profile; expected in this harness, but a person clearing data would lose it)

bugs.title: Newspaper picture and quote do not match the headline
bugs.actual: Peace talks scene and a Putin embassy quote under NK headline

suggestions.what: Spell out the header meters (Approval, Stability, Legitimacy, Political capital, Tension) and give 'Approve 4' a plain label like 'Accept my staff's advice'
suggestions.goal_served: Understands the first screen without gaming conventions

suggestions.what: After each month, a line saying how the Ukraine war moved and what my choices did to it, with a 'what really happened' link
suggestions.goal_served: R1: see whether my choices would have ended it, and the real history

suggestions.what: Show the full nation list at a readable size, with the chosen country confirmed in words
suggestions.goal_served: R2: play a term without figuring out a video game

suggestions.what: Make the desk show the chosen option clearly after approving
suggestions.goal_served: Never be unsure what I decided

delight: The opening card as President Trump with the mission in plain words (shots/ruth-tablet/003-g1.png)
The month page showing 45 to 49 for how America sees me, with the quote from Trump (shots/ruth-tablet/011-uc2.png)
Real names and the real situation: Burnham, Takaichi, Mojtaba Khamenei, Merz

fun.reason: The first two months were absorbing to read; the freezes and the hostage detour cut it short.

clarity.reason: Story text is clear; abbreviations, 'Approve 4' and unclear decided state made me guess.

visual.reason: Handsome scenes and a newspaper; text on the dark desk is small and grey.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Feels like a good news programme with choices; a bit like a dashboard on the desk.

agency.reason: Staff picks do much of it; I could not see what leads to peace in Ukraine, and the screen froze when I wanted the map.

realism.reason: Real leaders and places; but the Ukraine war was absent from the debrief and the headline picture was wrong.

replay.reason: I would try once more if it did not freeze and if I could read the real history.

recommend.reason: I would not give it to my book club until it stays up and explains its own words; the idea is good.

quit_point: Month 3 as the US: I tapped Map to look for Ukraine, the screen stopped answering and stayed that way; second time after executing month 2 of the Term. I would have closed the tablet.
verbatim: I liked reading it, but when the screen stopped answering I closed it, and nobody had told me what 'Approve 4' meant.
